acts.title: The Rogue
acts.subtitle: Life on the Margins
acts.description: Fresh from Earth's collapse, you're just another desperate soul trying to survive in the black. Learn the rules of the frontier, make your first connections, and discover that trust is a luxury you can't afford.

keyEvents.name: Acquiring the Rust Bucket
keyEvents.description: Steal, salvage, or earn your first spaceworthy vessel

keyEvents.name: The First Mate
keyEvents.description: Recruit your first crew member - someone as desperate as you

keyEvents.name: The Knife in the Back
keyEvents.description: Your trusted contact sells you out to Corporate Security

narrativeText.intro: The year is 2149. Earth went bust. You barely escaped on a transport ship with nothing but the clothes on your back. Now you're stuck in the frontier systems where the Corps squeeze every credit from desperate colonists, and the only law is what you can enforce yourself.
narrativeText.outro: Betrayed and hunted, you realize the truth: in the black, everyone's looking out for themselves. Time to embrace what you've become - an outlaw.

acts.title: The Outlaw
acts.subtitle: Building a Reputation
acts.description: You've learned the hard way that playing by the rules gets you killed. Time to build your crew, choose your allies, and take what's yours. But every heist brings you closer to uncovering the Corporate conspiracy that destroyed Earth.

keyEvents.name: The Beaumonde Job
keyEvents.description: Pull off the heist that makes your name known across the system

keyEvents.name: Bonds of Blood
keyEvents.description: Your crew faces their demons, and you decide their fates

keyEvents.name: The Earth Files
keyEvents.description: Discover the Corporate conspiracy that caused Earth's collapse

narrativeText.intro: They know your name now. Some whisper it in fear, others in hope. You're building something - a crew, a reputation, maybe even a cause. But the Corps haven't forgotten your crimes.
narrativeText.outro: The truth about Earth changes everything. The Corps didn't just let humanity's homeworld die - they killed it for profit. Someone needs to pay.

acts.title: The Captain
acts.subtitle: Leading the Charge
acts.description: You command respect across the frontier. Multiple ships answer to you, and your decisions shape the fate of entire colonies. The faction war has begun, and everyone wants you on their side.

keyEvents.name: Admiral of Outcasts
keyEvents.description: Take command of a small fleet of allied ships

keyEvents.name: Haven in the Black
keyEvents.description: Establish your own base of operations

keyEvents.name: The Side You Choose
keyEvents.description: The faction war reaches its peak - pick your allegiance

narrativeText.intro: Captain. The title carries weight now. Ships rally to your banner, colonies seek your protection, and the Corps want your head. You're not just surviving anymore - you're leading a revolution.
narrativeText.outro: The choice is made. Your allies stand with you, your enemies prepare for the final battle. Everything you've built leads to this moment.

acts.title: The Legend
acts.subtitle: Destiny Awaits
acts.description: Your name will echo through history. The final battle approaches - will you become the Space Pirate Supreme who rules through fear, the Robin Hood who liberates the oppressed, or something else entirely? Your choices throughout this journey determine your legacy.

keyEvents.name: Master of the Frontier
keyEvents.description: Your influence reaches every corner of the system

keyEvents.name: Parting Ways
keyEvents.description: Your crew members face their own destinies

keyEvents.name: The Last Stand
keyEvents.description: The final confrontation that determines the fate of the frontier

endings.name: The Pirate King
endings.description: You rule the frontier through fear and strength. The Corps bend to your will, the colonies pay tribute, and your fleet controls every trade route. You got everything you wanted - but at what cost?

endings.name: Hero of the People
endings.description: You broke the Corporate stranglehold and gave power back to the colonies. Children sing songs about you, and your crew became heroes in their own right. The frontier is free, and you made it happen.

endings.name: The Devil's Bargain
endings.description: You made a deal with the Corps - legitimacy and wealth in exchange for keeping the colonies in line. You're rich beyond measure, but your crew will never forgive you, and neither will history.

endings.name: Ghost of the Frontier
endings.description: You answer to no one. Neither Corp nor Colony can claim you. Your ship disappears into the black, a legend whispered in spacer bars. You're truly free - and utterly alone.

endings.name: The Redeemed
endings.description: You began as a scoundrel but became something more. Your past sins are forgiven, your crew stands proudly beside you, and the frontier has a chance at a better future. Sometimes, people can change.

narrativeText.intro: They tell stories about you in every port from Mars to the Belt. Some call you savior, others call you monster. But everyone knows your name. This is your final chapter.
narrativeText.outro: The black remembers everything - every choice, every betrayal, every act of kindness. Your story ends here, but your legend has just begun.
